decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Prior approval to the siting and appearance of the development is necessary. Consent is granted for the proposal as the development, as by reason of its siting, design and appearance it would not result in an undue adverse impact on the surrounding environment, the streetscene or the surrounding properties. The proposal will improve the existing situation.  The proposal is considered to meet the conditions specified in The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (Schedule 2 Part 24) (as amended). The proposal is also consistent with the provisions of Planning Policy Guidance Note 8: Telecommunications, policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-B.1.7 (Telecommunications) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan (UDP) and UDP Supplementary Planning Guidance (Sustainable Mobile Telecommunication Development May 2004).
description: Erection of a 12.5m high telecommunications monopole with six antennas and two associated equipment cabinets in place of existing infrastructure (Notice for prior approval for siting and appearance).
